title: Separator-free aqueous zinc–iodine batteries: an in situ dual-confinement interface enabling electrostatic reversible polyiodide capture/release
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00296J, Paper
Yamei Liu, Xiaofan Tian, Lu Wang, Lijin Xie, Zhenchao Li, Yuxin Ge, Zhao Li, Zhongchao Bai, Huakun Liu, Nana Wang, Guoxiu Wang, Xiaochuan Ren
A ∼24 µm integrated dual-confinement interface enables cathode–anode synergy in separator-free Zn–I2 batteries. CNF/Ni-MOF enhances interfacial polyiodide adsorption and conversion, while suppressing water activity, Zn2+ desolvation, and dendrites.
